title: input()
summary: Read one line from standard input and return it as a string, without the trailing newline.
description: **Always returns a str**, even when the user types digits. This is the single most common source of TypeError for beginners.
returns: str — the line entered, newline stripped.

raises.when: Input ends (Ctrl-D, or a closed pipe).

examples.title: Convert defensively
examples.output: Age: thirty\n'thirty' is not a number

real_world_usage: Interactive scripts only. Automation reads arguments, environment variables or files — a job that waits for input at 2am simply hangs.

common_mistakes.fix: TypeError: convert first with int() or float().
Any non-numeric entry crashes the program. Wrap it in try/except.

security_notes: Never pass input to eval() or exec(). Validate length and content before use.
